25
Mmabaawa du ho bɛ
1 # Luka 12.35-36; Adi 19.7 Ɛnna wɔde ɔsoro ahennie no bɛto mmabaawa du bi a wɔtasee wɔn nkanea firi adi sɛ wɔrekɔhyia ayeforɔkunu no ho. 2Na wɔn mu nnum yɛ mmadwemma na nnum nso nyɛ mmadwemma. 3Na wɔn a wɔnyɛ mmadwemma no faa wɔn nkanea no, wɔamfa ngo ankura; 4na mmadwemma no faa ngo guu ntoa mu kaa wɔn nkanea ho. 5Na ayeforɔkunu no kyɛreeɛ no, wɔn nyinaa ani kumee na wɔdedaeɛ. 6Na dasuo mu no, wɔtee nteamu sɛ: Hwɛ, ayeforɔkunu no ni oo! Momfiri adi nkɔhyia no! 7Ɛnna mmabaawa no nyinaa sɔre kekaa wɔn nkanea. 8Na wɔn a wɔnyɛ mmadwemma no ka kyerɛɛ mmadwemma no sɛ: Momma yɛn mo ngo no bi, na yɛn nkanea redunnum. 9Na mmadwemma no buaa sɛ: Dabi, ɛrenso yɛn ne mo; na monkɔ wɔn a wɔtɔn mmom nkyɛn nkɔtɔ mo deɛ! 10Na wɔrekɔ akɔtɔ bie no, ayeforɔkunu no baeɛ, na wɔn a wɔasiesie wɔn ho no ne no kɔɔ ayeforɔhyia no ase, na wɔtoo pono no mu. 11#Luka 13.25; 13.27 Na akyire yi no, mmabaawa a aka no nso ba bɛkaa sɛ: Owura, Owura, hini yɛn! 12#Mat 7.23 Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, menni mo. 13#Mat 24.42 Enti monwɛn, na monnim da anaa dɔn ko no, (a Onipa Ba no reba.)#25.13 Tete atwerɛ a wɔgye to mu binom mfa deɛ ɛwɔ nkahyɛmu no nka ho.
Nkoa pa ne akoa bɔne ho asɛm
(Luka 19.12-27)
14 # Mat 21.33 Na ɛte sɛ onipa bi a ɔretu kwan akɔ baabi, na ɔfrɛɛ ɔno ara ne nkoa, na ɔde deɛ ɔwɔ hyɛɛ wɔn nsa. 15#Rom 12.6 Na ɔmaa ɔbaako talente nnum, na ɔbaako mmienu, na ɔbaako nso baako, sɛdeɛ wɔn mu biara ahoɔden teɛ; na ɔtuu kwan. 16Na ntɛm ara deɛ ɔnyaa talente nnum no kɔe, de kɔyɛɛ adwuma na ɔnyaa ho talente nnum. 17Saa ara na deɛ ɔnyaa mmienu no nso kɔnyaa mmienu kaa ho. 18Na deɛ ɔnyaa baako no deɛ, ɔkɔ kɔtutuu fam, na ɔde ne wura no sika no sieeɛ. 19Na ɛkyɛreeɛ no, nkoa no wura no bae, na ɔne wɔn bɛbuu nkonta. 20Na deɛ ɔnyaa talente nnum no bae, de talente nnum kaa ho baa sɛ: Owura, talente nnum na wode hyɛɛ me nsa. Hwɛ, manya talente foforɔ nnum maka ho. 21#Luka 16.10 Ne wura no see no sɛ: Mo, akoa pa ne nokwafoɔ, woadi kakra yi ho nokorɛ, mede wo bɛsi nnoɔma pii so; kɔ wo wura anigyeɛ mu! 22Na deɛ ɔnyaa talente mmienu no baa sɛ: Owura, talente mmienu na wode hyɛɛ me nsa. Hwɛ, manya talente foforɔ mmienu maka ho. 23#Mat 25.21 Ne wura no see no sɛ: Mo, akoa pa ne nokwafoɔ, wadi kakra yi ho nokorɛ, mede wo bɛsi nnoɔma pii so; kɔ wo wura anigyeɛ mu! 24Na deɛ ɔnyaa talente baako no nso baa sɛ: Owura, menim wo sɛ woyɛ onipa a woyɛ den a wotwa faako a wonnuaeɛ, na woboaboa ano faako a womfa mpeteeɛ; 25enti mesuroe, na mede wo talente no mekɔsiee fam. Hwɛ, w’adeɛ ni! 26Ɛnna ne wura no bua see no sɛ: Akoa bɔne ne onihafoɔ, wonim sɛ metwa faako a mennuaeɛ, na meboaboa ano faako a memfa mempeteeɛ? 27Ɛnneɛ anka ɛsɛ sɛ wode me sika no kɔhyɛ sikasesafoɔ nsa, na meba a, mabɛgye m’adeɛ ne ɛho nsiho. 28Enti monnye ne nsam talente no, na momfa nkɔma deɛ ɔwɔ talente du no! 29#Mat 13.12 Na obiara a ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no na wanya aboro so; na deɛ ɔnni bie no deɛ, deɛ ɔwɔ no mpo wɔbɛgye afiri ne nsam. 30#Mat 8.12 Na akoa a ne ho nni mfasoɔ no, momfa no nkɔto no ntwene akyirikyiri sum no mu; ɛhɔ na osu ne setwerɛ wɔ.
Atemmuda kɛseɛ no
31 # Mat 16.27; Adi 20.11-13 Na Onipa Ba no bɛba n’animuonyam mu a n’abɔfoɔ nyinaa ka ne ho no, ɔbɛtena n’animuonyam ahennwa so. 32#Rom 14.10 Na ɔbɛboaboa amanaman nyinaa ano n’anim. Na ɔbɛpaepae wɔn mu sɛdeɛ odwanhwɛfoɔ paepae nnwanten ne mmirekyie mu. 33#Hes 34.17 Na ɔde nnwanten no bɛgyina ne nifa, na ɔde mmirekyie no agyina benkum. 34Ɛno na ɔhene no bɛse wɔn a wɔwɔ ne nifa no sɛ: Mo a m’Agya ahyira mo, mommra mmɛfa ahennie a wɔasiesie ama mo firi wiase mfitiaseɛ no nni! 35#Yes 58.7 Na ɛkɔm dee me, na momaa me biribi diiɛ, na sukɔm dee me, na momaa me nsuo nomee, meyɛɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, na mofaa me kɔɔ mo fie; 36medaa adagya, na mofiraa me ntoma, meyaree, na mobɛhwɛɛ me, medaa afiase, na mobaa me nkyɛn. 37#Mat 6.3 Ɛnna nnipa tenenee no bɛbua no sɛ: Awurade, da bɛn na yɛhunuu wo sɛ ɛkɔm de woɔ, na yɛmaa wo aduane, anaasɛ sukɔm de woɔ, na yɛmaa wo nsuo nomeeɛ? 38Afei da bɛn na yɛhunuu wo sɛ woyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ na yɛfaa wo kɔɔ fie, anaasɛ woda adagya, na yɛfiraa wo ntoma? 39Afei da bɛn na yɛhunuu wo sɛ woyare, anaasɛ woda afiase, na yɛbaa wo nkyɛn? 40#Mmb 19.17; Heb 2.11 Na ɔhene bɛbua ase wɔn sɛ: Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, sɛ moyɛ maa me nuanom nketewa yi mu baako yi, moyɛ maa me.
41 # Mat 7.23; Adi 20.10; 20.15 Ɛnna ɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ benkum no nso sɛ: Mo a wɔadome mo, momfiri me so nkɔ daa ogya a wɔasiesie ama ɔbonsam ne n’abɔfoɔ no mu! 42Na ɛkɔm dee me, na moamma me biribi anni, sukɔm dee me, na moamma me biribi annom; 43meyɛɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, na moamfa me ankɔ mo fie, medaa adagya, na moamfira me ntoma; meyaree na medaa afiase, na moammɛhwɛ me. 44Ɛnna wɔn nso bɛbua sɛ: Awurade, da bɛn na yɛhunuu wo sɛ ɛkɔm de woɔ anaasɛ sukɔm de woɔ, anaasɛ woyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, anaasɛ woda adagya, anaasɛ woyare, anaasɛ woda afiase, na yɛammɛsom woɔ? 45Ɛnna ɔbɛbua wɔn sɛ: Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, sɛ moanyɛ amma nketewa yi mu baako yi, moanyɛ amma me. 46#Yoh 5.29 Na yeinom bɛfiri hɔ akɔ daa ahoyera mu; na nnipa tenenee no bɛkɔ daa nkwa mu.

Ɛnna wɔde ɔsoro ahennie no bɛto mmabaawa du bi a wɔtasee wɔn nkanea firi adi sɛ wɔrekɔhyia ayeforɔkunu no ho. Na wɔn mu nnum yɛ mmadwemma na nnum nso nyɛ mmadwemma. Na wɔn a wɔnyɛ mmadwemma no faa wɔn nkanea no, wɔamfa ngo ankura; na mmadwemma no faa ngo guu ntoa mu kaa wɔn nkanea ho. Na ayeforɔkunu no kyɛreeɛ no, wɔn nyinaa ani kumee na wɔdedaeɛ. Na dasuo mu no, wɔtee nteamu sɛ: Hwɛ, ayeforɔkunu no ni oo! Momfiri adi nkɔhyia no! Ɛnna mmabaawa no nyinaa sɔre kekaa wɔn nkanea. Na wɔn a wɔnyɛ mmadwemma no ka kyerɛɛ mmadwemma no sɛ: Momma yɛn mo ngo no bi, na yɛn nkanea redunnum. Na mmadwemma no buaa sɛ: Dabi, ɛrenso yɛn ne mo; na monkɔ wɔn a wɔtɔn mmom nkyɛn nkɔtɔ mo deɛ! Na wɔrekɔ akɔtɔ bie no, ayeforɔkunu no baeɛ, na wɔn a wɔasiesie wɔn ho no ne no kɔɔ ayeforɔhyia no ase, na wɔtoo pono no mu. Na akyire yi no, mmabaawa a aka no nso ba bɛkaa sɛ: Owura, Owura, hini yɛn! Na ɔbuaa sɛ: Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, menni mo. Enti monwɛn, na monnim da anaa dɔn ko no, (a Onipa Ba no reba.)


Na ɛte sɛ onipa bi a ɔretu kwan akɔ baabi, na ɔfrɛɛ ɔno ara ne nkoa, na ɔde deɛ ɔwɔ hyɛɛ wɔn nsa. Saa ara na deɛ ɔnyaa mmienu no nso kɔnyaa mmienu kaa ho. Na deɛ ɔnyaa baako no deɛ, ɔkɔ kɔtutuu fam, na ɔde ne wura no sika no sieeɛ. Na ɛkyɛreeɛ no, nkoa no wura no bae, na ɔne wɔn bɛbuu nkonta. Na deɛ ɔnyaa talente nnum no bae, de talente nnum kaa ho baa sɛ: Owura, talente nnum na wode hyɛɛ me nsa. Hwɛ, manya talente foforɔ nnum maka ho. Ne wura no see no sɛ: Mo, akoa pa ne nokwafoɔ, woadi kakra yi ho nokorɛ, mede wo bɛsi nnoɔma pii so; kɔ wo wura anigyeɛ mu! Na deɛ ɔnyaa talente mmienu no baa sɛ: Owura, talente mmienu na wode hyɛɛ me nsa. Hwɛ, manya talente foforɔ mmienu maka ho. Ne wura no see no sɛ: Mo, akoa pa ne nokwafoɔ, wadi kakra yi ho nokorɛ, mede wo bɛsi nnoɔma pii so; kɔ wo wura anigyeɛ mu! Na deɛ ɔnyaa talente baako no nso baa sɛ: Owura, menim wo sɛ woyɛ onipa a woyɛ den a wotwa faako a wonnuaeɛ, na woboaboa ano faako a womfa mpeteeɛ; enti mesuroe, na mede wo talente no mekɔsiee fam. Hwɛ, w’adeɛ ni! Ɛnna ne wura no bua see no sɛ: Akoa bɔne ne onihafoɔ, wonim sɛ metwa faako a mennuaeɛ, na meboaboa ano faako a memfa mempeteeɛ? Ɛnneɛ anka ɛsɛ sɛ wode me sika no kɔhyɛ sikasesafoɔ nsa, na meba a, mabɛgye m’adeɛ ne ɛho nsiho. Enti monnye ne nsam talente no, na momfa nkɔma deɛ ɔwɔ talente du no! Na obiara a ɔwɔ no, wɔbɛma no na wanya aboro so; na deɛ ɔnni bie no deɛ, deɛ ɔwɔ no mpo wɔbɛgye afiri ne nsam. Na akoa a ne ho nni mfasoɔ no, momfa no nkɔto no ntwene akyirikyiri sum no mu; ɛhɔ na osu ne setwerɛ wɔ.

Na Onipa Ba no bɛba n’animuonyam mu a n’abɔfoɔ nyinaa ka ne ho no, ɔbɛtena n’animuonyam ahennwa so. Na ɔbɛboaboa amanaman nyinaa ano n’anim. Na ɔbɛpaepae wɔn mu sɛdeɛ odwanhwɛfoɔ paepae nnwanten ne mmirekyie mu. Na ɔde nnwanten no bɛgyina ne nifa, na ɔde mmirekyie no agyina benkum. Ɛno na ɔhene no bɛse wɔn a wɔwɔ ne nifa no sɛ: Mo a m’Agya ahyira mo, mommra mmɛfa ahennie a wɔasiesie ama mo firi wiase mfitiaseɛ no nni! Na ɛkɔm dee me, na momaa me biribi diiɛ, na sukɔm dee me, na momaa me nsuo nomee, meyɛɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, na mofaa me kɔɔ mo fie; medaa adagya, na mofiraa me ntoma, meyaree, na mobɛhwɛɛ me, medaa afiase, na mobaa me nkyɛn. Ɛnna nnipa tenenee no bɛbua no sɛ: Awurade, da bɛn na yɛhunuu wo sɛ ɛkɔm de woɔ, na yɛmaa wo aduane, anaasɛ sukɔm de woɔ, na yɛmaa wo nsuo nomeeɛ? Afei da bɛn na yɛhunuu wo sɛ woyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ na yɛfaa wo kɔɔ fie, anaasɛ woda adagya, na yɛfiraa wo ntoma? Afei da bɛn na yɛhunuu wo sɛ woyare, anaasɛ woda afiase, na yɛbaa wo nkyɛn? Na ɔhene bɛbua ase wɔn sɛ: Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, sɛ moyɛ maa me nuanom nketewa yi mu baako yi, moyɛ maa me.
Ɛnna ɔbɛka akyerɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ benkum no nso sɛ: Mo a wɔadome mo, momfiri me so nkɔ daa ogya a wɔasiesie ama ɔbonsam ne n’abɔfoɔ no mu! Na ɛkɔm dee me, na moamma me biribi anni, sukɔm dee me, na moamma me biribi annom; meyɛɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, na moamfa me ankɔ mo fie, medaa adagya, na moamfira me ntoma; meyaree na medaa afiase, na moammɛhwɛ me. Ɛnna wɔn nso bɛbua sɛ: Awurade, da bɛn na yɛhunuu wo sɛ ɛkɔm de woɔ anaasɛ sukɔm de woɔ, anaasɛ woyɛ ɔhɔhoɔ, anaasɛ woda adagya, anaasɛ woyare, anaasɛ woda afiase, na yɛammɛsom woɔ? Ɛnna ɔbɛbua wɔn sɛ: Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, sɛ moanyɛ amma nketewa yi mu baako yi, moanyɛ amma me. Na yeinom bɛfiri hɔ akɔ daa ahoyera mu; na nnipa tenenee no bɛkɔ daa nkwa mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
